title: Final Point Protocol
style: cinematic progressive trance, female computerized announcer, swelling pads, 336 Hz subharmonic drone, big drop, choir layer on second drop, 128 BPM, pickleball match point, breath and tension
lyrics:
[Intro — 336 Hz drone, pad swell]
(female computerized, deliberate)
Final point protocol initiated.
Match point detected.
Systems engage. Breathe. Play.

[Build — pad rises, ticking hi-hat]
(layered whisper)
match point... match point... match point...
(crowd ambience swells)

[Verse 1 — half-sung]
Score: ten-nine-two
The line is in your view
Two paddles, two minds
One breath finds the lines

[Pre-Drop]
Three... two... one... serve.

[Drop 1 — full trance, 128 BPM]
Match point breathe play
Match point breathe play
The protocol holds the way
Match point breathe play

[Verse 2]
The rally goes long
The rally goes wrong
The rally goes home
The rally goes on

[Pre-Drop]
Three... two... one... return.

[Drop 2 — biggest, choir layer]
Match point breathe play
Match point breathe play
The protocol holds the way
Match point breathe play

[Bridge — 336 Hz pure tone, pad alone]
(soft)
You held the line
You held the breath
You held the moment
The point is yours.

[Outro — pad fades, 336 Hz lingers]
Final point protocol complete.
Match... won.
(silence)
